reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-09-01 against the July 2026 Reserve Transparency Report, report no. 00024/3.0408/AUP/99/1180-14/1/VIII/2026, issued by KAP Jojo Sunarjo & Rekan and signed 2026-08-05. The agreed-upon procedures report is explicitly not an audit, review, opinion, or other assurance engagement. Its July 28, 2026 table reports ORI030 at Rp4,005,850,153, PT Bank Central Asia at Rp3,397,831,673, PT Bank Ina Perdana at Rp1,121,465,194, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia at Rp117,678,550, Indodax at Rp2,000,491,416, Duitku at Rp1,207,064,492, and PINTU at Rp1,000,320,628, totaling Rp12,850,702,106 against 12,694,960,138 IDRX in circulation, or 101.23% coverage. The image appendices reconcile the table rounding: BCA shows Rp3,397,831,672.63, Bank Ina shows Rp1,112,545,318.61 plus Rp8,919,875.88, BRI shows Rp117,678,550, Indodax highlights an estimated IDR value of Rp2,000,491,416, Duitku shows a balance of Rp1,207,064,492, PINTU highlights total IDR of Rp1,000,320,628, and GHP Consulting's July 27 statement confirms Rp4,005,850,153 in the ORI030 secondary account. The API index exposes record 16, created 2026-08-10, with this PDF URL. The pinned PDF fetched in this review has SHA-256 759e81902267cbac64bc130d3ff0949923ea4617f41de1f52b482fb054a951d. Mapping decision: the old USD deposits held in escrow at GHP Consulting row is retired and replaced by ORI030; the old combined Bank Ina Perdana, Nobu Bank, and Bank Permata row is retired and replaced by separate Bank Central Asia and Bank Ina rows; the BRI, Indodax, Duitku, and PINTU rows retain their institution labels but are replaced with the July balances and percentages. The seven July rows are the full composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KAP Jojo Sunarjo & Rekan agreed-upon-procedures Reserve Account Report as of 2026-07-28, using the seven institution or instrument balances in its reserve table; PDF SHA-256 759e81902267cbac64bc130d3ff0949923ea4617f41de1f52b482fb054a951d
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The AUP identifies all seven reserve rows and the report's image appendices show the supporting BCA, Bank Ina, BRI, Indodax, Duitku, PINTU, and ORI030 account evidence. It does not provide an assurance opinion, establish account segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, disclose rehypothecation limits, or identify the underlying depository institution for the ORI030 account confirmed by GHP Consulting.
